item.title: Coast churches prepare for Ash Wednesday
item.description: Now that carnival is over, many South Mississippians are looking ahead to the season of Lent. Many churches tomorrow will offer Ash Wednesday masses or services to distribute ashes and start the 40 days of Lent, preceding Easter. Ashes are a symbol of repentance and our own mortality. The distribution of ashes is practiced by many Christian denominations. Categories: Featured,...

item.title: City of Ocean Springs warns against email scam
item.description: OCEAN SPRINGS, Miss. (WXXV)- There’s a scam making the rounds in Ocean Springs. Emails are being sent out claiming to be from city officials and are asking for invoices to be paid. City officials urge you to never share banking details or any personal information. The best course of action is to block and delete the emails immediately. Categories: Local...
